nodes.name: Oscar defends three-act structure
nodes.description: Oscar insists that the script's three-act design and intermission are essential to its intended psychological rhythm.
evidence:
OSCAR
Three acts. The structure is deliberate. Remove the intermission and the psychological rhythm collapses.

nodes.name: Diana challenges script running time
nodes.description: Diana acknowledges Oscar's artistic reasoning but presses him specifically about the production's length.
evidence:
DIANA
I understand the rhythm, Oscar. I am asking about running time.

nodes.name: Oscar refuses to shorten script
nodes.description: Oscar states that the script must remain exactly as written at one hundred and forty minutes with one intermission.
evidence:
OSCAR
Three acts. One intermission. One hundred and forty minutes. That is the script as written by me and that is how it stays.

nodes.name: Diana answers phone call
nodes.description: Diana receives a call on her old cracked flip phone and tersely confirms Friday while resisting a prior request.
evidence: Diana's phone RINGS. She pulls it from her pocket -- an old NOKIA FLIP PHONE, its case cracked down one side. She flips it open.

DIANA
(into phone)
Yes. Friday. No -- we have talked about this.

nodes.name: Oscar remarks on Diana's old phone
aliases: Oscar remarks on Diana's old phone
nodes.description: After Diana ends the call, Oscar comments on how outdated her phone is, highlighting her practical attitude.
evidence:
DIANA
It works. That is enough.

OSCAR
(eyeing the phone)
Do they still manufacture those?
She claps it shut and tosses it on the desk.

nodes.name: Diana discovers coffee machine is broken
aliases: Diana discovers coffee machine is broken
nodes.description: Diana reaches for coffee but stops when she notices again that the office machine is out of order.
evidence:
DIANA (CONT'D)
Forgot. Again.
She reaches toward the COFFEE MACHINE before catching sight of the OUT OF ORDER sign.

nodes.name: Diana declines coffee errand
nodes.description: Oscar suggests getting coffee nearby, but Diana refuses because she has no time and returns to the script.
evidence:
OSCAR
There is a place two blocks down.
She returns to the desk and picks up the script.

DIANA
No time.
